title: Caged Soul Ascension
description: A luminous, ethereal figure kneels inside a glowing vertical cage of light. From the figure's face, a stream of floating, pastel-colored lips and eyes drifts upward toward a radiant starburst of divine light at the top of the composition.
prompt: A glowing translucent human silhouette kneeling inside a tall ethereal cage made of light beams and twisted pillars. A trail of floating pastel purple and yellow lips and eyes emerges from the figure's face, floating upward toward a brilliant heavenly starburst of light. Dreamlike surreal scene with sparkles, soft pastel clouds, and iridescent glowing atmosphere, mystical and transcendent mood.
